title: GitHub: brayonpi/hexstellar
description: Stars: 705, Forks: 52 | Turn any AI agent into a computational researcher. HexStellar Cortex delivers software-accelerated optimization, quantum computing, scientific computing, decision intelligence, and verifiable execution through a Python CLI and API—with certainty labels, verification receipts, examples, and a free sandbox. Start instantly: pip install hexstellar
